|lore=Planetary scale shield projected from surface of Endor moon. Protected second Death Star during construction. Only another superlaser could penetrate it while operational.
|game_text=Deploy on table. While your [Endor] objective on table (and opponent's [Endor] objective not on table) opponent generates no Force at Endor system. Twice per game, may ▲ an Imperial admiral. (Immune to Alter.)

|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Endor Shield (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V1-D-endorshield-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-endorshield022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/endorshield.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/endorshield.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Endor Shield”. Text: “Deploy on table. While your [Endor] objective on table (and opponent's [Endor] objective not on table) opponent generates no Force at Endor system. Twice per game, may ▲ an Imperial admiral. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Endor Shield (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 3 October 2022<ref name="img-endorshieldca1ccff">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/endorshield.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 commit ca1ccff] (3 October 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/endorshield.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Endor Shield” → “Endor Shield” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Endor Shield”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “Deploy on table. While your [Endor] objective on table (and opponent's [Endor] objective not on table) opponent generates no Force at Endor system. Twice per game, may ▲ an Imperial admiral. (Immune to Alter.)”
